AI is a powerful tool for marketing managers but that it has pitfalls and opportunities, and that it can be used for higher order learning, but it cannot replace human judgment in the transfer of tacit knowledge.

AI will have a major impact on marketing, but it will be limited to tasks that can be fully automated and that do not require human interaction and explainability.
